evidence.description: INV-2 complete flow {cert,deploy,bid,lease,manifest} present and ordered; INV-3 no sleep 30, poll loop present; INV-5 negative half holds (no mint/swap in deploy path). BUT spec's mandatory NO-MOCK sandbox-2 E2E DONE gate (spec 60-68) is unrun and send-manifest success never confirms 'service up' (spec 62).

Every tx signs --from $AKASH_KEY_NAME (own keyring wallet). No console-api.akash.network, no credit-card, no managed-wallet path in active code. INV-1 holds at the code level (the oracle's INV-1 ENFORCEMENT is weak — see FIND-204 under test_adequacy — but the code itself leaks nothing).

The three behavioral fail-closed cases (create code!=0, no bids, lease code!=0) DO genuinely assert rc!=0 AND empty stdout AND no downstream call — that part is non-gameable and proves HARD 0.24 for those paths. But the fake self-confirms every version-sensitive shape (dseq/bid/lease/keys-show), INV-1 is checked on comment-stripped source, and there is no manifest-fail / cert-create / service-up case.

Tested failure paths (deploy code!=0, no dseq, no bid, lease code!=0, lease-not-active) all exit !=0 BEFORE the line-122 dseq print, so NO dseq leaks on those failures — HARD 0.24 holds there. FAIL because send-manifest exit-0-but-service-down (FIND-206) is fail-OPEN: the script prints the dseq for a deployment whose container may never boot, the exact defect B1 targets (spec 11-13).
